mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES mobility has risen monotonically from -44.6% to -39.3% over four weeks, signaling gradual return to office routines. This sustained upward trend in workplace attendance will drive weekday retail footfall and lift RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks relative to the baseline period.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES improved 5.3 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the mean of the prior 28 days, or WORKPLACES reverses to decline below -42% in week t+1.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM mobility has improved steadily from -22.3% to -15.0%, indicating reduced anxiety about essential shopping and normalization of consumer confidence. This confidence signal will spill over into discretionary retail-and-recreation spending, producing net positive RETAIL_REC movement over four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM improved 7.3 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days remains below -30%, or GROCERY_PHARM deteriorates below -18% in week t+1.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS mobility has surged from 17.3% to 42.6% over four weeks, indicating strong outdoor activity substitution. If PARKS momentum continues above 35% while RETAIL_REC remains depressed below -30%, outdoor leisure is crowding out indoor retail. This substitution effect will suppress RETAIL_REC recovery over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS sustained above 35% AND RETAIL_REC below -30%
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds -25%, or PARKS falls below 30% in week t+1.

If TRANSIT crosses above -40% in week t+1, this signals regime shift toward unrestricted mobility, triggering accelerated RETAIL_REC recovery in weeks t+2 to t+4.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 7.3 percentage points over four weeks
failure_condition: TRANSIT does not cross -40% in week t+1, or RETAIL_REC declines further in weeks t+2 to t+4 despite TRANSIT improvement.

evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL declined 2.6 points while WORKPLACES improved 5.3 points
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days does not exceed the prior 28-day mean, or RESIDENTIAL rebounds above 12% in week t+1.

This seasonal peak will persist for two weeks before declining, during which RETAIL_REC will remain suppressed as consumers substitute outdoor leisure for indoor shopping. RETAIL_REC will only recover after PARKS normalizes below 30%.
candidate_trigger: PARKS above 40% for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC rises above -25% in weeks t+1 to t+2 while PARKS remains above 40%, or PARKS falls below 30% within one week.

candidate_trigger: TRANSIT remains below -44% AND WORKPLACES remains below -38% in week t+1
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds the prior 28-day mean, or either TRANSIT or WORKPLACES improves by more than 3 percentage points in week t+1.
